A few things to know.

Can I use my existing WhatsApp number?

Check your provider's onboarding options first. Keeping the WhatsApp Business app alongside API access depends on your account and supported setup; some connections require migration.

Can I send my product PDF every day?

The planned workflow supports subscribed customers and approved marketing templates where required. Customers must be able to opt out. Sending is subject to Meta's rules, approval and messaging limits.

Is this already connected to my store?

No. This is an interactive landing-page demo. Live messaging, inventory, orders and payments require your business account, backend workflows and payment integration.

Can a staff member take over a conversation?

Human handover should be part of your live setup so staff can handle substitutions, customer questions and delivery issues.
